method: A fixed natural-language percentage-point frame locates one assertion sentence containing the complete measure and both condition labels, extracts exact decimal strings, verifies the citation, and calculates with rational arithmetic.

limitations: One explicitly framed percentage-point question and one CC BY article were evaluated.
The measure and both labels must occur in one assertion sentence; table extraction and multi-sentence linkage are not covered.
This does not establish general numeric extraction, scientific reasoning, or transfer across publishers.
The domain route uses a bounded source pattern and is not an induced general-purpose math language model.
